0.0: We've received a request from the Maple Alliance. They're currently gathering supplies, and they asked us to chip in. The supplies we sent them were stolen by monsters, so I'd like you to hunt down the monsters that did this and get back #b20 #t4032919##k. #bGaga#k will be waiting when you've got them.

yes.0: Recover #b20 #t4032919##k from monsters and deliver them to #rGaga#k.

no.0: We're all reeling from Vita's passing, but this is no time to stand idly by. Joining the Alliance will finally allow us to strike back at the Black Wings. I had hoped you'd want to help us do this, but I see I was wrong.

npc.0: You must recover #b20 #t4032919##k from the monsters and deliver them to #rGaga#k.
